title.zh: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%
title.en: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%

current_state.zh: Alphabet Q3 2026财报后股价下跌逾12%至285美元，市值缩水近5000亿美元；市场聚焦EPS不及预期和AI基础设施投入导致的负自由现金流。尽管云收入同比增长103%，多家机构下调评级或目标价，技术形态受损，分析师预计短期维持区间震荡，但超卖状态和接近52周低点可能限制进一步下跌。
current_state.en: After Alphabet's Q3 2026 earnings, shares fell more than 12% to $285, erasing nearly $500B in market value; investors focused on the EPS miss and negative free cash flow from AI infrastructure spending. Although Cloud revenue grew 103% YoY, multiple institutions cut ratings or price targets, technical damage occurred, and analysts expect near-term range-bound trading, though oversold conditions and proximity to the 52-week low may limit further declines.

updates.title_zh: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%
updates.title_en: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%
updates.what_changed_zh: Alphabet 2026 年第三季度财报显示，谷歌云收入创纪录增长 103% 至 307 亿美元，主要受企业 AI 基础设施和 TPU 需求推动，但净利润下降约 25%，原因是 87 亿美元的股权投资损失和巨额资本支出使自由现金流转为负值，导致该股盘后交易下跌 9.84%。
updates.what_changed_en: Alphabet's Q3 2026 results showed record Google Cloud growth of 103% to $30.7B driven by enterprise AI infrastructure and TPU demand, but net profit fell about 25% on $8.7B in equity-investment losses and heavy capex pushed free cash flow negative, sending the stock down 9.84% in after-hours trading.

updates.title_zh: 谷歌Q3财报解读：云收入翻倍但搜索广告增长放缓、自由现金流缺口扩大，股价盘后大跌10%
updates.title_en: 谷歌Q3财报解读：云收入翻倍但搜索广告增长放缓、自由现金流缺口扩大，股价盘后大跌10%
updates.what_changed_zh: 后续解读补充了更多财报细节：Alphabet Q3营收约1276亿美元、同比增长25%但低于LSEG预期的1282亿美元；搜索及其他收入增长12%至633.5亿美元，但广告总收入约820亿美元低于834亿美元预期；自由现金流约负90.7亿美元，连续第二个季度为负且缺口较上季约59亿美元扩大；当季还计入52亿美元欧盟罚款付款及TPU库存增加的影响；调整后EPS为2.67美元，低于3.02美元预期；公司维持2026年1950亿至2050亿美元资本开支指引，并预计2027年显著增加。
updates.what_changed_en: Follow-up analysis added more earnings details: Alphabet Q3 revenue was about $127.6B, up 25% YoY but below the $128.2B LSEG estimate; Search & other revenue rose 12% to $63.35B while total ad revenue of about $82B missed the $83.4B estimate; free cash flow was about -$9.07B, negative for a second consecutive quarter with the gap widening by about $5.9B QoQ; the quarter included a $5.2B EU fine payment and higher TPU inventory; adjusted EPS was $2.67 versus $3.02 expected; the company maintained 2026 capex guidance of $195B-$205B and expects a significant 2027 increase.
updates.current_state_zh: Alphabet Q3 2026财报显示云业务收入307.09亿美元、同比增长103%并推动营业利润率扩张，但总营收和广告收入低于预期，搜索广告增长放缓，自由现金流连续第二季度为负且缺口扩大，GAAP每股盈利受SpaceX投资未实现亏损拖累，调整后EPS也低于预期，股价盘后下跌约10%；公司维持2026年资本开支指引并预计2027年显著增加。
updates.current_state_en: Alphabet's Q3 2026 results showed Google Cloud revenue of $30.709B, up 103% YoY, and expanded operating margin, but total revenue and ad revenue missed expectations, search advertising growth slowed, free cash flow was negative for a second consecutive quarter with a wider gap, GAAP EPS was hit by an unrealized SpaceX investment loss, and adjusted EPS also missed; the stock fell about 10% after hours. The company maintained its 2026 capex guidance and expects a significant increase in 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Alphabet reported Q3 revenue below expectations, with cloud revenue more than doubling and operating margin expanding, while search advertising growth slowed, free cash flow turned negative for a second quarter, and the stock fell about 10% after hours.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Alphabet reported Q3 revenue below expectations, with cloud revenue more than doubling and operating margin expanding, while search advertising growth slowed, free cash flow turned negative for a second quarter, and the stock fell about 10% after hours.
